author: TurkishDelite
body:
i have to suggestions that i think would be cool on avicus.

Mini Games
i hate it when a game has 50 people in it and it gets cluttered making it hard to navigate to areas or do stuff like rushing and defending on maps, so i think there should be a sub-gamemode in each gamemode called Mini-Nebula or Mini-CTW and ect. in these mini nebulas there would be maps specifically made for mini games like this where you would have the maps made for like 20 or less players

Voting Rotations
i think it would be cool if there were a rotation were players could vote what map they want to play on, incase you would think that map will get overplayed you could make it that the map can not be voted until 5 different maps are played after it or we doing something different like 3 random maps pulled out of the database and after a minute of deciding which map you want, the map with the most votes will be played on.
